newsitem.title: UK: UK money market rates tighten, shortage uncovered.
newsitem.headline: UK money market rates tighten, shortage uncovered.

text.p: UK cash rates tightened as a 950 million stg liquidity shortage was only partly taken out, while on the gilt repo market the 6.0 percent gilts due 1999 were very special.

* Overnight cash was quoted at 7-1/2 7.0 percent in late trade after Bank of England assistance totalled 598 million, having traded around 6.0 percent for most of the day. Operators were reluctant to sell bills and there was no assistance in the early or midday rounds.
* Bank of England allotted 4.5 billion stg in repo and secured loan facilities starting October 10 and traders said short dates should ease in next few weeks.
* On gilt repo market, overnight general collateral was quoted at similar levels to those on cash market.
* 6.0 percent gilts due 1999 traded at 3.0 percent for one week, while overnight business was as low as 2.5 and possibly 2.0 percent.
* Some interest was reported in term GC, with one month traded at 5.74 percent and six months reported at 5.78 percent.
